new_scholarship.name: Denison Merit-Based Scholarships
new_scholarship.deadline: Aid is applied for during the admission process only
new_scholarship.application_period: All students who submit an admission application are considered for merit-based scholarships, which are awarded at the time of admission.
new_scholarship.application_method: Automatic - all applicants are considered for merit scholarships; a separate application is required only for need-based aid
new_scholarship.description: Denison University offers merit-based scholarships ranging from $5,000 per year to full tuition. Every student who applies for admission is considered automatically and awards are made at the time of admission. International students are eligible for exactly the same need-based financial aid and merit-based scholarships as domestic students and permanent residents.
new_scholarship.best_fit: Any applicant to Denison, including international applicants, who is considered automatically for merit funding at admission.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: All students submitting an admission application are considered for merit-based scholarships. International students receive the same institutional need-based aid and merit-based scholarships as domestic students and permanent residents.
